snippet.title: A Case of the Crabs: Rehash! -Trailer1
snippet.description:
A complete remake/remaster/rehash of the award winning Flash game: A Case of the Crabs! Play as smart-ass detective, Nick Bounty, in this hilarious point & click adventure and hunt down a nefarious counterfeit crab ringleader!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387150/A_Case_of_the_Crabs_Rehash/
Itch.io: https://pinheadgames.itch.io/a-case-of-the-crabs-rehash
Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/CrabsRehash/539744
